blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Rondae Hollis-Jefferson could only smile when told of another similarity between him and the late Kobe Bryant, whom he not only idolized but also mimicked. Sunday’s Game 1 victory by the Tropang 5G over the Magnolia Hotshots in the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals marked the third game Hollis-Jefferson played since suffering a torn Achilles, an injury that Bryant famously had in his NBA career. “I took the Kobe thing too far,” Hollis-Jefferson joked after the 92-70 win at Ynares Center here.
